name: Taihou Daigaku Byouin no Kyouki - Dai Go Ya
original_name: 大鳳大学病院の狂気 第五夜
source:
Taiho University Hospital's female doctor, Rieko captures Rig, a human rights inspector who came to investigate the hospital.
All human rights being ignored, her arms and legs are removed and she is exposed in the corridor, beaten and forced to excrete.
She gradually becomes dog-like animal.
Can she return to the life as a human? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047445.html]DLsite English[/url]]
